Maven source archive: com.badlogicgames.gdx:gdx-box2d-gwt:1.9.3.
Only the GWT emulation sources are included. They replace JNI Box2D wrappers
with the bundled pure Java JBox2D engine for Vita. Source copyright and license
notices are retained in every Java file.
